create_directory_watcher: create a DirectoryWatcher instance to watch a directory for new pickle observation files with rate limiting
start_directory_watcher: start the DirectoryWatcher timer to begin consuming pickle observation files from the watched directory
stop_directory_watcher: stop the DirectoryWatcher timer and join the background thread to cleanly shut down observation consumption
pause_unpause_directory_watcher: pause or unpause the DirectoryWatcher timer to temporarily halt or resume observation file consumption
get_most_recent_viz_directory: get the path of the most recently created viz_data directory under the HOME_ROBOT_ROOT hardware experiments path
